title: Marsiya Fatima Zehra ka sunaye koi
body:
Marsiya Fatima zehra ka sunaye koi
Zulm jo un pa howe hain wo bataye koi
Qatile zhera pe karta hon tabarra har roz
Meri awaz se awaz milaye koi
Kalma goyun ne jalaya hai dar e Zehra ko
Jalte sholo se unhe aa ke bachaye koi
Har azadar ye HI kheta hai kar ke matam
Zulm jo un pa howe kaise bholaye koi
Sadma Baba ka tha Mohsin ka naya sadma hai
Fatima Zehra ka ab dil na dukhaye koi
Darmiya hain dar o diwar ke binte Ahemad
Aag aa kar dar e Zehra ki bochaye koi
Aaj hasnain pe guzri hai qayamat logo
Apna gham aaj na bhole se manaye koi
Pasliya todi gayi ho gaya Mohsin bhi shahid
Khe do aada,n se sitam aur na dhaye koi
Binte Ahemad ne ye haidar se wasiyat ki thi
Mera doshman meri mayyet ME na aaye koi
Chahate honge yehi gaib ME mere moula
Qabre Zehra pa diya ja ke jalaye koi
Jo bhi zehra ki kanize hain unhe yaad rahe
Be rida ho ke na bazar ME jaye koi
Ye tamanna hai duwa bhi hai yehi hasrat bhi
Turbate Fatima Zehra ko banaye koi
Qabar e Ahmad se sada aati rhe rhe ke Zaheer
Ashk zehra ki musibat pa bahaye koi
